blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.why: **стать → станете** — perfective verb, 2nd person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Я ___ (сделать, pf., fut. 1st sg.) несколько кадров.
exercises.why: **сделать → сделаю** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.
exercises.prompt: I'm going to take some pictures.

exercises.q: Я ___ (дать, pf., fut. 1st sg.) вам две подсказки.
exercises.why: **дать → дам** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.
exercises.prompt: I'm going to give you two hints.

exercises.q: Я ___ (взять, pf., fut. 1st sg.) завтра лодку на тест-драйв.
exercises.why: **взять → возьму** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.
exercises.prompt: I'm going to take my boat for a test drive tomorrow.

exercises.q: Жан и Филипп ___ (посмотреть, pf., fut. 3rd pl.).
exercises.why: **посмотреть → посмотрят** — perfective verb, 3rd person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.
exercises.prompt: Jean and Philippe are going to take a look.

exercises.q: Я не ___ (позволить, pf., fut. 1st sg.) Тому помыкать мной.
exercises.why: **позволить → позволю** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.
exercises.prompt: I'm not going to let Tom push me around.

exercises.why: **прийтись → придётся** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.
exercises.prompt: I'm going to have to stay.

exercises.q: ___ (поехать, pf., fut. 1st sg.) на Гавайи кораблём.
exercises.why: **поехать → Поеду** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.
exercises.prompt: I'm going to Hawaii by ship.

exercises.q: Вопли и крики никуда тебя не ___ (привести, pf., fut. 3rd pl.).
exercises.why: **привести → приведут** — perfective verb, 3rd person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.
exercises.prompt: Yelling and screaming is not going to get you anywhere.

exercises.q: На этом корыте далеко не ___ (уехать, pf., fut. 2nd sg.).
exercises.why: **уехать → уедешь** — perfective verb, 2nd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.
exercises.prompt: You're not going to get far in this old tub.

exercises.q: Я ___ (купить, pf., fut. 1st sg.) кожаный ремень.
exercises.why: **купить → куплю** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.
exercises.prompt: I'm going to buy a leather belt.

exercises.q: Мы ___ (провести, pf., fut. 1st pl.) отпуск на Корсике.
exercises.why: **провести → проведём** — perfective verb, 1st person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.
exercises.prompt: We are going to spend the vacation in Corsica.
